user.title: Ryton Home Automations
user.description: Add Ryton Home Automations to this house.

data_description.pairing_code: The code from the website for this house. Leave empty for a house with no internet that runs from a schedule file.

reconfigure.title: Pair with the website
reconfigure.description: Enter a new pairing code from the website for this house. Pairing again replaces the house's earlier key.

data_description.pairing_code: The code from the website for this house. Leave empty for a house with no internet that runs from a schedule file.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Ryton Home Automations is already added.
abort.reconfigure_successful: This house is now paired with the website.

error.invalid_pairing_code: That pairing code was not accepted. It may be mistyped, already used, or expired.
error.cannot_connect: The website could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.

preview.name: Preview schedule
preview.description: Works out which day each date is and the time of every automation, without switching anything.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first date to work out. Today if left empty.

days.name: Number of days
days.description: How many dates to work out.

schedule_file.name: Schedule file
schedule_file.description: The schedule file in the configuration folder.

output_file.name: Output file
output_file.description: If given, the list is written to this file in the configuration folder and only a summary is returned.

reload_schedule.name: Reload schedule
reload_schedule.description: Takes the schedule from its file, sets the Jewish Calendar to match it, and runs the house from it.

schedule_file.name: Schedule file
schedule_file.description: The schedule file in the configuration folder.

run_through.name: Run through
run_through.description: Carries out automations one after another without waiting for the clock, to test them. This really switches devices. With no start date it runs every automation of every day in the schedule.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Run the automations of dates from this one. Leave empty to run every automation of every day in the schedule.

days.name: Number of days
days.description: How many dates, when a start date is given.

each_day_once.name: Each kind of day once
each_day_once.description: Skip a date whose kind of day already ran, when a start date is given.

check_wait_seconds.name: Seconds to wait before checking
check_wait_seconds.description: 10 in normal running. A smaller number makes the run-through faster.

output_file.name: Report file
output_file.description: The report is written to this file in the configuration folder when the run-through ends.

stop_run_through.name: Stop run-through
stop_run_through.description: Stops a run-through that is in progress.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Checks the website for a newer schedule now, and sends the house's room list and year preview if they changed.

add_change.name: Add a temporary change
add_change.description: Stores one of the client's temporary changes. It applies from now until its last date, then the house goes back to the schedule.

change.name: Change
change.description: The change, in the temporary changes format: from, until, days, kind and what the kind needs.

remove_change.name: Remove a temporary change
remove_change.description: Removes a temporary change before it runs out.

list_changes.name: List temporary changes
list_changes.description: Returns the temporary changes and the rooms whose scheduling is switched off.

set_room_scheduling.name: Set a room's scheduling
set_room_scheduling.description: Switches scheduling off for a room, so automations skip it, or back on. It stays until it is set again.

days_in_dates.name: Days in a span of dates
days_in_dates.description: Returns which of the schedule's days occur between two dates, for choosing the days a temporary change touches.

start_away.name: Turn away mode on
start_away.description: Turns away mode on from now. It runs nothing, a preset of the schedule, or only some rooms, until motzei Shabbos or Yom Tov or the end of a date.

run.name: What runs
run.description: "off" for nothing, "rooms" for only the rooms listed, or the identifier of a preset.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: With "rooms": the rooms that keep running.

until.name: Until
until.description: "motzei" for an hour after havdalah at the end of the coming Shabbos or Yom Tov, or a date.

end_away.name: End away mode
end_away.description: Ends the client's away mode now. Each room goes to where the schedule has it.
